# A Study of Two Columns

Left column starts here and the text keeps going for a few lines so that the layout looks like a real paper with columns that are read from top to bottom first.

A second paragraph in the left column adds more lines so that the column is tall enough to be found by the gutter check and ends the left column.

Right column text begins at the top and must be read only after the left column is finished, never interleaved with it line by line as a naive extractor would do it.

The last paragraph of the right column is short but still spans a few lines to keep the two columns about the same height on the page.
